name: Davidson Center
notes: Low rough-ashlar mass in Umayyad vaults, one storey above the walkway, flat roof, modern glazed entrance on the west side facing the walkway (notes L6; lobby K:046/K:047 glass doors). Fix round 1: height 5.0 -> 3.2 m (top -39.96, 3.2 m above the walkway at the NW corner, 4.6 m on the W face over its edge ground, up to 7 m on the S face down the slope). K:044 is taken from its roof terrace (planter box lower left, railing and stair down to the park at right): the vanishing point of the Southern Wall courses puts the eye at about -38.5, so the roof is at about -40. The entrance is three glazed bays in the middle of the W face (position L); other faces blank (vault walls; the S face is against the city wall).
